title: Conducting loops rotating through a half-plane magnetic field: the induced current of each loop matched to its graph
summary: Four loops turn clockwise about O with a field only for x > 0. The current follows how fast loop area crosses the field boundary: P constant then reversed (3), Q two pulses each way (2), R a pulse in and out (1), S zero because one lobe enters as the other leaves (4) - option C.
subject: Physics
topic: Loops rotating through a half-plane field - the induced current follows the rate at which loop area crosses the field boundary
subtopics: Faraday's law: emf = -dPhi/dt, with Phi = B x (area inside the field)
A rotating sector's straight edge sweeps area at r^2 omega/2 while crossing the field boundary
No crossing, no current: a loop wholly inside or outside the field
Lenz's law and the sign of the current; lobes of one loop that circulate the same way
concepts: Only the part of a loop inside x > 0 carries flux, so i ~ dA_in/dt
P half-disc: area enters steadily for half a turn and leaves for the next: + constant then - constant (3)
Q two sectors: + T/6 pulse, gap, + pulse, then - pulse, gap, - pulse (2); R one sector: a pulse in at the start and a pulse out after T/2 (1)
S two opposite sectors: one crosses out as the other crosses in; both lobes circulate the same way, so the flux is constant and i = 0 (4); opposite senses would add, not cancel
P3 Q2 R1 S4: option C
formulas: dA/dt = r^2 omega/2 per edge crossing
answerValue: P->3, Q->2, R->1, S->4 (option C; key C)

methods: MathonGo solution (their Q31 = Physics Q.15) read first as the conceptual reference (area in the field); its S argument (figure-8 with opposite area vectors cancelling) is not correct and is not used - the answer (C) agrees
Sector bookkeeping: the overlap of each sector with the half-plane, piecewise in the turn angle; sympy for the half-disc; i ~ dA/dt in each sixth of the turn
Green's theorem on each loop exactly as drawn (arcs and wires, with the direction the wire runs): flux / B = closed integral of max(x, 0) dy; i(t) by finite differences - P3 Q2 R1 S4
Control: S drawn as a crossing figure-8 (opposite senses) gives pulses of twice one edge's rate, matching no List-II graph - only the same-sense loop gives zero
Every option audited: A, B and D each fail on at least one row
The page engine extracted and run in Node: map P3 Q2 R1 S4, answer C
Official key printed with the paper (checked last): Q.15 -> C
